 WELCOME TO BAKERY WORLD

Your bakery. Your adventure.

You’re the head baker! Explore the shop and earn three little badges: Cookie Champion, Cake Artist, and Taste Tester.

Play or taste a treat

At the oven, catch 5 of the 10 flying cookies by standing on their glowing landing spots. At the cake studio, match the frosting and topping on the order. Taste all 5 pastries at the counter. Step onto the dough pillow for a bounce. Walk into the glowing circle in front of the mixer to get whisked around the bowl and launched out of the bakery! Baking magic floats you safely home.

Your badges last for this visit. Returning to the entrance keeps them.
